decision: Prefer an absence-only callback-free exit preflight for the confirmed editor-switch failure before implementing nativeCancel ownership/retirement. The earlier full retirement plan remains chronological alternative/follow-up evidence, not the preferred next increment.
why_coherent: Actual public area.type switch reaches checked ED_area_newspace -> ED_area_exit while original Node-link handler context still targets that live area/region.

Refuse before Paint teardown/native exit callbacks/context mutation if an affected actual registered native Node-link modal is present. Original operation stays live and receives native motion/Finish/Esc normally.

The new refusal runs no callbacks; the existing borrowed RNA/area continuation pointers cannot be invalidated by this query. No new global callback lifetime proof is required for this refused corridor.

No NodeTree/embedded owner/Node/socket/customdata read is required, so graphstorage family coverage is not inferred or expanded. This is a refusal policy, not a positive Node or physical-contact lease.
hard_non_goals: No nativeCancel, synthetic release/Esc, event reordering, contact serial/tail policy, receipt, positive owner, operator lifetime allocation, drag UID, bNodeLinkDrag field, tree resolver or new ordinary Pencil lease.
No automatic completion/cancellation, rollback or generic Node lifetime closure.
No bare null-region modal guard; keep original region/context alive by preventing the destructive action.
No detached helper/source-build milestone. Deliver actual query + early consumers + connected behavior checks together.

query_contract.execution: Read-only nonallocating current-state scan with no context setters, Python context/provider calls, poll/modal/cancel/UI callback, report dispatch or lifetime-token allocation. Native type helper does only pointer/flag comparisons.
query_contract.membership: Resolve current G_MAIN/manager/window lists before reading their members; find requested actual area/region through live active-screen membership. Scan the actual owning windows' modalhandlers, not a previously saved handler/window pointer. Context area/region values are compared to live target addresses only. A foreign current C.window must not hide the original owning window. No saved pointer is dereferenced and no replacement ownership is captured.
query_contract.native_profile: Use current WM_operatortype_find('NODE_OT_link', true) and a pure same-translation-unit native profile helper comparing actual Node invoke/modal/poll/cancel callbacks and required flags. WM_operatortype_find is registry lookup only (wm_operator_type.cc92-113); no native poll. Presence never authorizes invocation of those callbacks.
query_contract.root: For an actual listed OP handler with root handler.op==native registered NODE_OT_link and original context targeting requested area/region, return false. No customdata/tree/node reads. DO_FREE/pending-removal matching native handler is conservatively still present until actual list cleanup; retry later.
query_contract.macro: Actual WM registration stores macro root, active child is root.opm (WM7924-7928; wm_operator_type482-508). Support refusal for an active native Node child only after actual live root.macro membership proves which child may be inspected. Never cancel child or root. Malformed/ambiguous active macro relevant to the target is conservative refusal; unrelated known nonNode macro behavior stays unchanged. Exact implementation must define/test ambiguity handling, rather than treating unknown as native or granting success without proof.
query_contract.unknown: A target-relevant actual handler with missing/mismatched current type/profile or malformed root/active-child relation cannot provide a cancellation grant. Query returns conservative unknown/refusal where Node cannot be safely ruled out. This is not proof of arbitrary corrupted-pointer safety. Exact native well-formed root case closes the confirmed corridor.
query_contract.null_ids: No ID/session UID/lifetime token is needed for this instantaneous callback-free presence refusal. Current live list membership plus actual type/profile is enough to deny exit; zero tree/owner/type-lifetime IDs cannot accidentally grant cancellation. No tree ID is even read. Missing Main/manager/window/target-membership needed to establish absence is query-unknown and must be explicitly refused or excluded for that consumer; do not silently prove absence.
query_contract.region_rule: Whole-area exit matches native handler.context.area to target area. A region-only request matches its original registered region; do not block an unrelated header merely because the operation uses another WINDOW region. Missing/ambiguous original region in an otherwise relevant native Node handler is refusal, not permission to proceed.
query_contract.non_apple: Apple-only implementation/consumers; preserve nonApple source behavior. No patched-Windows/device claim from stock baseline.

confirmed_noop_corridor.fact: Setter stores requested butspacetype; getter reports requested type only while that transient field is nonempty.

Public update resolves owning screen window, sets C window/area and region=null, calls ED_area_newspace(...,true). On false it clears butspacetype=SPACE_EMPTY, restores prior window/area/region and returns.

Newspace computes native type and prior header alignment, temporarily clears area.type.exit for skip=true, then calls checked ED_area_exit. On false it restores area.type.exit and returns before spacetype/type/region swap.
New presence check must be first, before existing Paint guard and area.type.exit, region loop, area handler removal or modal context replacement.
New region presence check must be first, before Paint guard, region.type.exit, local handler removal or modal region replacement.

confirmed_noop_corridor.result: Refused public area.type assignment leaves real spacetype/type, region lists, Node runtime/drag/handler, graph, View2D and original context ownership unchanged. Transient butspacetype and temporary type.exit are restored. After native Finish/Esc/RMB ends the handler, retry reaches normal exit. No new report currently exists in the RNA false branch.

multi_target_caveat: Existing bool signatures do not make every caller atomic. Early callback-free preflight must cover ALL affected targets before any Paint/native callback or geometric/state mutation in each admitted caller. A late ED_area_exit false is insufficient for callers that already mutated layout. Consumers without this proof stay explicitly deferred.

caller_requirements.required: First query in exit gives a callback-free false before Paint/native callbacks; optionally preflight newspace before temporary type.exit change for simpler no-op proof. Verify false restores type.exit and RNA clears butspacetype/context. No new callback path.
First query before any callback; false prevents BKE_area_region_free and unlink. Actual caller must not mutate region first.
Direct false prevents area free, but higher join callers below need their own early preflight.
Preflight BOTH areas before existing Paint teardown and before either ED_area_exit; avoid first exit/callback followed by second refusal.

Preflight all relevant original areas before existing Paint helper, screen_areas_align, geometry edge writes, trim/split. Their current early Paint-only preflight sites demonstrate placement; do not wait for screen_delarea.
If claimed, preflight all relevant regions/areas before Paint guard, animtimer/sound/scrubbing/active-region writes and before loops. Otherwise explicitly defer global screen-exit atomicity.

caller_requirements.caller: offscreen exit and other direct region/context replacement
caller_requirements.required: Distinct path bypasses ED_area_exit; defer unless exact actual relevance/caller behavior is inspected and integrated. No global teardown claim.

implementation_surface: Pure native Node callback-profile helper/header plus WM read-only actual-handler/target absence query and early Apple exit/caller consumers. No origin/binding/drag/tree ownership fields. First implementation must name exactly the admitted consumers and demonstrate no-op refusal end to end.
same_increment_validation: Connected exact-source O0/O2 query -> actual checked newspace/area/region/RNA false bodies, not a helper-only assertion. Model boundaries for live intrusive lists/registries/context setters explicit.

Actual registered root Node handler: affected area switch refused before all Paint/Node/area/region callbacks; callbacks/cancel/poll/alloc/free counters remain zero; op/handler/drag are untouched; no region context is cleared.

Exact public RNA false outcome: area.type remains NODE_EDITOR; butspacetype becomes SPACE_EMPTY; old area.type.exit restored for skip=true; previous context restored in proper area-before-region order; no unrequested report or pending mutation leak.
No owner and native Finish/Esc/RMB -> handler removed -> retry succeeds; ordinary source linking and native existing-input detach semantics unchanged.

Wrong area/region/window, foreign C.window, multiple windows, DO_FREE pending, zero IDs, missing Main/manager/target, replaced/unregistered type profile, macro active nativeNode/list mismatch, unrelated native modal controls. No tree/customdata/Node/socket read under any case.
Multi-area/region/screen consumers only if all-target early preflight proves zero prior mutation/callback on refusal; retain explicit unprotected path list.

Apple/nonApple compile profiles, affected existing Paint/Knife/Node/UI tests, full host/preflight and independent review before one exact native target build/package/compiled gate. No build/test is run by this plan.
Target/device check later confirms Finish/Cancel then retry remains usable. Stock Windows attempt5 stays native baseline failure evidence.
ux_tradeoff: Editor switching/removal pauses during a live affected Node link. The user finishes or uses existing native Esc/RMB Cancel, then retries. This preserves graph/native cancellation semantics and removes the confirmed destructive transition. The current RNA false branch is a silent no-op; clear user feedback could be a separate concrete product choice, but this addendum does not invent a new Cancel button or promise a report.
evidence_boundaries: Exact target/source current overlay and root-observed stock5.1.2 failure. No new production/test/CI change, compiler execution, runtime probe, target build or device acceptance.
